# Click the address bar, enter Norwegian's traffic figures page, and go
pyautogui.click(350, 80)  # address bar
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'a')
time.sleep(0.1)
pyautogui.typewrite('https://media.uk.norwegian.com/tag/traffic-figures', interval=0.02)
time.sleep(0.1)
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(2.5)
